comments.author: wander123
comments.body: what is the best place to sell mace and nutmeg at the moment ??

comments.author: BIakeC
comments.body: You usually want to sell them at your home nations allied and territory ports, otherwise your be charged a small tax for selling in other nations' ports. In the case of spices however, I found they sell the best in the Iberia culture sphere ports, followed by anywhere else in Northern Europe from Bordeaux to the Baltic Sea. Avoid selling them in the Mediterranean Sea, as they have a lower profit margin for some reason.
